verdict.rationale: Sunbiz is an online state filing and registry service, so user-configurable background automation (for example, scheduled annual-report filing or auto-renewals) is a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence pack documents only manual, one-off online filings and payments. The 'automatic prompt' to print a check voucher is a UI behavior, not an automation a user sets up to run autonomously, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
